cause_quote: The new swipe runtime ran `if (this.host.navDrawerOpen) { this.opened(); }` when it connected, and `opened()` moved focus with `(this.focusable()[0] ?? drawer)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });`.
user_saw: If the mobile drawer’s gesture code loaded while a sidebar menu was open, the menu lost focus and the first Escape press dismissed an unrelated tooltip instead of the menu.
summary: The fix sets initial focus when the shell opens the drawer and makes late gesture attachment preserve the current focus.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit’s parent, where the mobile drawer already existed and an end-to-end test verified that the first Escape closed a nested session menu while leaving the drawer open. The draggable-drawer commit added an asynchronous import whose completion could refocus an already-open drawer after the user had entered a nested menu.
